evidence.quote: We propose a $35 million class fund distributed automatically to identified members. Brightline would separately pay up to $3 million in court-approved fees and expenses;
We accept Brightline's latest term sheet: a $30 million class fund distributed automatically, plus up to $2.5 million in court-approved fees and expenses,

summary: Class counsel raised fees alongside its opening fund proposal, and the parties negotiated both before agreeing on class relief. The transcript does not show a tradeoff between fees and the fund, fee-driven self-interest, defense leverage, or a misleading declaration.
